goal: GDS layout of the programmable 2x2 MZI modelled in OPA-MZI-001, with balanced dummy heaters following OPA-MZI-002
pdk: gdsfactory generic PDK (example technology, not a foundry process)

circuit_model_mapping.theta: top internal-arm heater of the core MZI
circuit_model_mapping.dummies: heater_dummy_in and the bottom internal-arm heater are unpowered and balance the heater loss

four_optical_ports.detail: inputs face west, outputs face east, all 0.5 um wide

port_order_matches_model.detail: in_top/out_top are waveguide 0 of the circuit model (phi and a act on it)

identical_heaters.detail: all six heaters are the same cell, so powered and dummy heaters add the same loss

balanced_internal_arms.detail: top and bottom arms differ by 0.00e+00 um (tolerance 0.001 um)

balanced_input_output_paths.detail: heater plus fan-out length is equal on both inputs and on both outputs

fanouts_do_not_cross.detail: the four fan-out S-bends do not overlap or cross (overlaps: [])

heaters_do_not_overlap.detail: no overlapping heater footprints among 6 heaters

gds_reproducible.detail: regenerating the cell gives an identical GDS file

limitations: Generic example PDK: layers, design rules and heater geometry are not a foundry's
The coupler length is a placeholder; the 50:50 length for a real stack must come from simulation (next step: Meep or a mode solver)
No foundry DRC deck has been run; checks are geometric sanity checks only
No electrical routing to bond pads and no grating or edge couplers yet
Heater phase per milliwatt and thermal crosstalk are not modelled
